Reading & listening · iOS concept

PREBOOK

The next good book, within reach.

An iOS concept bringing book discovery, purchasing, reading, and listening into a single experience, with a calm visual system and familiar library patterns.

Format
iOS app concept
Focus
User flows, wireframes, UI system
01 Overview02 Decisions03 Design04 Reflection

01 / The context

A useful starting point.

PREBOOK explores the journey from discovering a book to accessing it in a personal library. Its design artifacts include research questions, competitive exploration, user flows, wireframes, and mobile interface studies.

The design challenge

Readers need help navigating a broad catalog while balancing their interests, budget, and time. Discovery and purchase should connect clearly with the reading or listening experience that follows.

02 / Design decisions

What shaped
the experience.

01

Create multiple paths to a book

Categories, search, recommendations, and book details offer different ways to browse and choose.

02

Connect formats in one place

The book-detail concept brings reading and listening actions together, alongside synopsis, rating, and purchase information.

03

Design the supporting states

Wireframes account for authentication, payment, empty states, search, and library management, supported by a blue-and-lavender visual system.

04 / Reflection

What this
work brings together.

This is an interface concept, with the strongest material in the discovery, library, and flow explorations. Further work should validate these journeys and refine the final content and reading/listening states before implementation.
